fusions.name: Wallbreaker
fusions.desc: Shoulders into everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, which deals 16 damage and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Undermine
fusions.desc: Strikes the target, which deals 30 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 10 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Warm Den
fusions.desc: Sets up a healing field where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Girth of a Pier
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your armour rises by 5%.
